desktop.install_title: Keep this as an app on this computer
desktop.launcher_description: A window of its own, with no tabs or address bar, and a place in your applications.
desktop.linux_text: The launcher opens this page in a window of its own where a Chromium browser is installed, and in your usual browser where not.
desktop.chromium_text: Your browser can do this without anything to download: in its menu, choose Save and share, then Install page as app (or Create shortcut, with Open as window ticked). Edge calls it Apps, then Install this site as an app.
desktop.safari_text: In Safari: File, then Add to Dock. It becomes a window of its own with an icon in the Dock.
desktop.other_text: Bookmark this page. Chrome, Edge and Brave can go further: Create shortcut, with Open as window ticked, gives it a window and a menu entry of its own.
desktop.installed: This is running as an app on this computer.
